_comment: The ONLY place product facts live. build.py substitutes {{key}} in every page and in llms.txt, and refuses to build if a page hardcodes a price. Change a price here, rebuild, done. Verified 2026-09-30: prices via `asc iap/subscriptions pricing summary` (USA); free allowance = Store.swift freeAllowance; iOS floor = project.yml deploymentTarget.
definition_en: Untouched is an iPhone app that keeps the original files of the videos and photos you choose on your iPhone, so they play instantly and at full quality even when Optimize iPhone Storage keeps the rest of your library in iCloud.
definition_zh: Untouched 是一款 iPhone App：把你挑中的视频和照片原件留在 iPhone 本机，即使「优化 iPhone 储存空间」把图库其余部分放在 iCloud，这几项也能随点随播、保持原画质。
